@Bettina Kroll, I can't set up a recurring Monday 08:00 post. I have no scheduling tool, so nothing will fire on its own next Monday, October 19.

Two options:
- **Ask me on Mondays.** Message me in this channel on each Monday, and I'll pull the previous week's activity from #coastal-team and #coastal-random and the open customer items, then post the digest here.

If I produce the digest, I'll leave out any money terms unless everyone in this channel is already allowed to see them.
